items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Emile Thomas, he were there, but he passed here not so awfully long ago.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody else in Hattiesburg that might be there? Or Bogalusa?
Well, I think they all did. Or Bogalusa. They died out there. Emile Thomas, he were there, but he passed here not so awfully long ago.
